summary: Synchronous anthropic.messages.create in a Flask view blocks the request thread for the entire model latency (~1-3s p50, 10s+ p99), starving the 8-slot gunicorn pool at ~5 concurrent requests.

findings.message: anthropic.messages.create() is invoked synchronously inside the /summarize view. The request thread is held for the full external latency; with --workers 4 --threads 2 = 8 slots, the pool saturates at ~5 concurrent users. p99 latency of the LLM call is effectively unbounded (provider-side spike, rate limits).
findings.suggestion: Enqueue via Celery/RQ/sqs: `summarize.delay(text, callback_url=...)` and return 202 Accepted with a status endpoint. Alternative: stream via SSE / WebSocket and free the worker slot before the LLM finishes.
